search.tool_desc: Search for products using a keyword query. Returns a list of matching products with names and prices.

args.arg_desc: The search keywords describing the desired product

returns.arg_desc: Numbered list of products with names and prices

click_product.tool_desc: Click on product N from search results to view its details, options, and price. N is 1-indexed.

click_option.tool_desc: Select a product option value (e.g., a specific size or color) on the current product page.

returns.arg_desc: Updated product page with selection highlighted

click_buy_now.tool_desc: Purchase the currently viewed product with the selected options. Completes the shopping task.

click_back.tool_desc: Return to the search results page from a product detail page.
